# Agentron

> Agentron (Agentron Studio) is local-first AI agent orchestration and workflow automation by Julian M. Kleber — multi-agent design, chat assistants, RAG, heap specialists, and optional desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
> Documentation: https://docs.agentron.rocks/
> Downloads: https://docs.agentron.rocks/download/
> Source: https://github.com/cap-jmk-real/agentron

- [Download desktop app](https://docs.agentron.rocks/download/)
